rule: VelvetOS Core registers office MCPs. An instance binds a subset via mcpBind. No secrets in git. HTTP servers live in .cursor/mcp.json. Desktop-only / stdio servers stay in ~/.cursor/mcp.json or Codespace secrets (see mcp.desktop.example.json).

servers.cloud: Team MCP + optional OAuth; anonymous free tools work

servers.whyNotProject: Needs a Google service-account JSON. Project mcp.json would override a working global config. Put credentials in ~/.cursor/mcp.json.
Personal WhatsApp (lharries) is a local Go bridge + QR on the owner Mac. Infobip HTTP is only for instances that already pay Infobip.

altHttp.when: instance already has Infobip — still send=false on VF

servers.whyNotProject: Needs GEMINI_API_KEY. This is Google AI Studio / Gemini API — not the gemini.google.com Plus/Advanced subscription. Do not install aliargun/mcp-server-gemini or RLabs-Inc/gemini-mcp. Do not put the key in project mcp.json. Cloud Agent must not open gemini.google.com (security alerts).
servers.failover: python3 scripts/vf_gemini.py (live model list) → ChatGPT + Perplexity + WebSearch. Without a key write חסר מפתח Gemini. Never invent a body.

servers.whyNotProject: Needs OPENAI_API_KEY. This is the OpenAI API — not the chatgpt.com Plus/Pro subscription (help.openai.com: Plus does not include API). Do not put the key in project mcp.json. Cloud Agent must not open chatgpt.com (security alerts).
servers.failover: python3 scripts/vf_chatgpt.py (live model list) → Gemini API + Perplexity + WebSearch. Without a key write חסר מפתח ChatGPT. Never invent a body.

servers.whyNotProject: adelaidasofia/instagram-mcp is stdio Python + Meta long-lived token (INSTAGRAM_MCP_*). Project mcp.json must not hold secrets. Desktop ~/.cursor/mcp.json, Codespace secrets, or future remote Team MCP.
servers.cloud: Cloud Team MCP namespace instagram verified 2026-09-09 (live_check.ok + get_profile velvets_cloud + list_media). Codespace stdio remains a local path.
servers.failover: Canva export + Drive create_file + Gmail send_message same turn (#ממתין-ל-כלי-IG)
